connector.name: Codelogic MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: An MCP Server to utilize Codelogic's rich software dependency data in your AI programming assistant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package codelogic-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codelogicincengineering account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CODELOGIC_SERVER_HOST
env.description: url to the CodeLogic server e.g. https://myco.app.codelogic.com

env.name: CODELOGIC_WORKSPACE_NAME
env.description: the workspace name that your code is scanned into

env.name: CODELOGIC_DEBUG_MODE
env.description: When enabled, additional debug files such as timing_log.txt and impact_data*.json will be generated. Defaults to false
